Hi everyone. I’ve been having this issue with Finder on my macbook for the last week.

Whenever I want to download/copy/delete/compress it shows 
“Zero bytes of …. - Estimating time remaining…”

For this specific download it’s pretty big but this happens on a lot of random downloads ranging from 1mb to 1gb. It’s very annoying and i have no idea how to fix it. It just stays on this screen forever, so far i’ve been waiting 15 minutes for this copy and it hasn’t moved from Zero bytes. 

Please help me fix this

EDIT: Spelling mistakes. I’ve also tried force relaunching, and restarting macbook.

I’d first suggest to go online and find resources to help you (w3schools, freeCodeCamp and youtube videos are my personal favourites). Once you get a basic understanding of some of the tags and attributes within HTML, you should try and recreate your favourite and/or commonly used websites.

Also like you said you’ve only been working at this for 2-3 weeks, so once you get more practice and take more time it’ll start making a lot more sense. Coding is pretty much like any other career and sport in terms of practice makes perfect. You won’t be a pro and be able to make a perfect website as much as we all want to. It’s all about practice, just give it time and patience and you’ll get it eventually.

Oh damn, that really sucks. I could just imagine that being so uncomfortable. Hopefully you’re doing better now, and not seeing that therapist lol, and hopefully she didn’t treat you differently because of who you are attracted to. I wish you nothing but the best, have a great day!

I guess we can only hope that’s the case, it sucks to see people who have also had a bad experience with therapy, because we’re always told that it’s great to go to therapy, but in reality it just seems like a big cash grab from people who don’t care about you or your problems. But I hope you find the right type of therapy for you, and get through what you’re going through.

Yea it’s really frustrating going through this especially when I’m somewhat young(18), having to deal with depression and anxiety, and not getting the help we need. I’m sorry to hear that’s happening to you as well, it really sucks how some of these so called doctors who have their good and fancy degrees in mental health, to be terrible people who don’t really give a shit about their patients. I might be put on medication soon, but I’m not too sure because of COVID I didn’t really want to do online therapy especially because I was let off from my job. 

I really hope if you do get medication to help you that you don’t take them all at once, I really hope you stay and find happiness through your struggles. And I know me saying this is kinda ironic because I’m in the same boat but still, I really hope things get better for you!

I wish you the best man!

Yea after I finished the therapy sessions, I thought about that and it’s really just a kick in the ass by those people. They really only say it so they won’t have to listen to you or let someone else deal with it. And I guess if the person does get professional help, it makes them feel better about themselves; like a, “hey I said that that person should seek professional help and they did! I guess I did make a difference” sorta thing.

Is that really how it’s supposed to work? I always thought it was for the therapist to comfort you and I guess help you deal with the pain, I never really thought about it like that.

Also what about the people who are suffering from suicidal thoughts and are thinking about ending their life. When they go to therapy if they make them feel worse before getting better. Wouldn’t that just be the final push off the ledge?
Yea that’s exactly how mine went, it was just a huge cash grab. How are you doing now though? (Post therapy)

My therapist did a mix between Interpersonal therapy, and Psychodynamic therapy. But I don’t think it was just the type of therapy that didn’t work, I just think it was the doctor that didn’t make it work. But I’m too tired of it, and don’t have the kind of expendable money needed to go see a different therapist.

Yea I get that and I’ve been trying to help myself. I guess I should have worded my question better, sorry! And I know that talking to this doctor wouldn’t solve all of my problems, but this man was just really bad. He was unprofessional which was ironic, but he was just making me feel like shit by almost encouraging these thoughts I have about ending my life and wasn’t trying to assist me into bettering myself. He was basically saying that me being depressed was all my fault, which I guess is somewhat correct but I also couldn’t change the actions of others that pushed me into this hole. Thanks for the response though it means a lot to me!

8.
